customer_name: Shanghai Xinzhi Software Co., Ltd. (上海新致软件股份有限公司)
business_problem: Shanghai Xinzhi Software needed a scalable way to help automotive sales teams cope with high staff turnover, expensive talk-track training, fragmented customer-profile information, and weak use of historical call data in coaching and conversion planning.
solution_summary: Shanghai Xinzhi Software built an automotive-sales copilot on Baidu AI Cloud using Qianfan ModelBuilder, Qianfan AppBuilder, and ERNIE-4.0-Turbo. The system ingests sales-conversation content and related customer information, then uses prompt-tuned large-model workflows to extract customer tags, concerns, resistance points, and intent labels. Qianfan AppBuilder organizes interview analysis, scoring, and recommendation delivery, while Qianfan ModelBuilder and ERNIE-4.0-Turbo handle talk-track quality checks, improvement suggestions, customer-insight analysis, and strategy guidance. The source also notes automatic connection to Baidu Search plugins to improve sales Q&A. The result turns each interaction into reusable data for manager dashboards, salesperson review, training, and standardized best-practice replication, helping the business shift from experience-led management to data-driven coaching and conversion optimization.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Orchestrates the sales-assistance workflows for conversation analysis, scoring, recommendation delivery, and review.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model development environment used to tune prompts and run customer-tag extraction, strategy analysis, and coaching logic.

solution_components.name: ERNIE-4.0-Turbo
solution_components.role: Supplies the base model that interprets sales conversations, generates insights, and powers intelligent Q&A and strategy recommendations.

solution_components.name: Baidu Search plugin
solution_components.role: Adds external retrieval support that improves the grounding and coverage of sales-question answering.

data_flow: Sales-conversation content and customer information are fed into Qianfan workflows, where ERNIE-4.0-Turbo and tuned prompts extract customer tags, concerns, and intent signals. The system then produces scores, talk-track improvement suggestions, and strategy recommendations that flow into manager monitoring, salesperson review, and training loops.
business_outcome: The sales copilot improved lead conversion, raised salesperson scores, reduced training time, lowered manual quality-inspection work, and gave managers a data-backed way to optimize coaching and market strategy.
metrics: The solution has already served 20+ enterprises, including Zheshang Bank.
architecture_clues: Prompt-tuning services were customized for customer-tag extraction, talk-track quality detection, improvement suggestions, scoring, and customer-insight analysis
The deployment converts historical conversation data into reusable coaching and strategy assets
The workflow supports both frontline sales review and manager monitoring through weekly regional and store comparison outputs

The project targeted three core problems: high turnover among sales consultants, high learning costs for talk-track knowledge, and weak use of past call data for strategy analysis (original: 销售顾问流动大，话术知识学习成本高…策略分析支撑少，过往通话数据难以发挥数据价值).

Baidu AI Cloud provided ERNIE-4.0-Turbo and prompt-tuning services for customer-tag extraction, talk-track quality inspection, improvement suggestions, reception scoring, and customer-insight analysis (original: 百度智能云提供ERNIE-4.0-Turbo基座大模型…提供Prompt提示词调优服务…如客户标签提取、话术质量检测、话术改进建议、接访评分生成、客户洞察分析等).

Through the Qianfan platform and prompt tuning, the system can accurately extract customer tags, concerns, resistance information, and intent labels to support intelligent Q&A and strategy recommendation (original: 通过百度智能云千帆大模型平台和提示词调优，能精准提取客户标签、关注点、抗性信息及意向标签，构建多维客户画像，并基于大模型实现智能问答与策略推荐).
Sales conversion increased 30%, average sales scores improved 25%, and the training cycle was shortened by 50% (original: 30% 销售转化率提升；25% 销售得分平均提升；50% 培训周期缩短).
